title: Second trial reporter Grace Hidayat
paragraphs: The 2nd trial for defamation against coastal voice reporters, Grace Hidayat, has been made.

According to the charges, Grace Hidayat published the alleged corruption of district road projects on September 2, 2025, which the prosecutor judged attacked the honor of an official, which was used: section 27A ITE Act.
The trial was held at Makassar State Court on March 18, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until April 15, 2026.
In matters of Grace Hidayat, Andi Pratiwi's legal power was denied access to a number of case files so that the defense rights were compromised.
Grace Hidayat works as a Coastal Voice reporter in Makassar, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The D.A. will read the charges to the next trial.
